Name: Penny Ponytail Hairstyle
Author: vsymbiote
Description:
[u]December 23rd, 2020[/u]

Merry Christmas, everyone. With the release of Stardew Valley 1.5, I have updated this mod to account for Penny's new beach sprites and portraits.

[u]April 25th, 2020[/u]

This mod was originally made back in 2016 by [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/penny-ponytail-hairstyle-1-2.113451/]Axiam over on Chucklefish Forums[/url]. Unfortunately, not only was the mod made pre-Content Patcher, it also hadn't been updated since 2018. With the recent release of Stardew Valley 1.4, this mod now lacked both a front facing portrait for Penny, as well as a proper sleeping Penny sprite, glitching during Penny's new 14 heart event, and anytime she went to bed.

Because Penny is best girl and I love this mod, I've gone ahead and created a new version-- version 1.3-- to fix these problems. In addition to the original portraits and sprites created by Axiam, I've added a new portrait and sprite to fix the above issues, and have also made the mod compatible with Content Patcher where it wasn't originally. No more directly replacing the game's files!

Do you love Penny? Do you want to see her with a cute ponytail? Then this is the mod for you :)

Requirements: SMAPI, Content Patcher.

Instructions: Unzip the folder into your Mods folder, and play away!

Downloads.Description: Updated for SDV 1.5, includes updated beach sprites.
